summary_en: 150,000 shares (2.53% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-14 at 08:45 JST at ¥2,135/share (previous close). Maximum outlay ¥320.25M. Results to be disclosed after market close. Execution window 2026-07-14 to 2026-07-21; block size ¥320.25M.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 13 July 2026, Niitaka's board of directors approved acquisition of up to 150,000 common shares (2.53% of issued shares excluding treasury) via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3). The block purchase will be executed on 14 July 2026 at 08:45 JST at the previous day's closing price of ¥2,135/share, with a maximum outlay of ¥320.25M. The acquisition window runs from 14 July to 21 July 2026. Results will be disclosed upon trade completion. Partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions.
